media.title: Bronisław Kaper — U.S. immigration manifest, Calexico, 1935
media.description: Sworn immigration manifest (U.S. Department of Labor, INS Form 548) for Bronisław Kaper at the Port of Calexico, California, recording his admission for permanent residence as a 'music composer' (born Warsaw, Poland; wife Eleonora Kaper). Part of Kaper's U.S. immigration record.

timelineEvents.title: Legal Permanent Entry
timelineEvents.label: 1 Nov 1935 · Permanent U.S. entry
timelineEvents.shortDescription: Kaper enters the United States for permanent residence through Calexico with Eleonora.
timelineEvents.longDescription: Enters for permanent residence at Calexico, CA from Mexicali, Mexico (Nov 1). On foot with Eleonora. Address: 6628 Franklin Ave., Hollywood.

places.publicNote: Mexicali is the Baja California border city from which Kaper and Eleonora entered the United States at Calexico for permanent residence. The map marker uses official city-level coordinates and does not identify the location of the historical Commercial Hotel.
